name: Espectros 1: Contacto
source:
The world was consumed in destruction after a strange race of beings appeared who only thought of feeding ... They are not Zombies, are they Aliens? It is an enigma where they came from.

A group of people come together over time trying to survive in this new world. Deaths, love affairs, disappointments, betrayals and much more are what will mark the course of this story.
